title: SagaMarkets
tagline: Decentralized Forex Trading Platform, which allows you to trade or leverage trade any forex pair
description:
Saga markets is a DEFX (Decentralized Forex Exchange) powered by Yellow’s Network Unified Balance. As of right now there isn’t much to be speculated with the Forex exchange rate in the cryptocurrency world, most of Forex brokers are behind KYC and fail to offer the decentralization needed in web3 world. Except of some fews of stablecoins of USD and Euro, but not with a forex borex type experience every forex trader knows.

Going through multiple KYC and routine checks is not web3 and that is why SagaMarkets is here to offer you web3’s version without missing any of the web2 important features.
how_its_made:
The project started with a backend powered by golang, which manages all the api calls coming from the frontend. After that the database (POSTGRES) stores all the traders positions info etc into the table.

The project that essentially powered SagaMarkets to receive USDC is Yellow's Network Unified balance which allows users transfer their tokens anywhere gasless
